name: io.github.akmalovaa/proxmox-mcp
title: Proxmox VE
description: Manage Proxmox VE nodes, VMs, containers, storage and snapshots. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Proxmox host IP or hostname.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Proxmox API port.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_VERIFY_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Verify the TLS certificate. Proxmox self-signs by default.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for each Proxmox API request.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_USER
environmentVariables.description: API user, including the realm.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_TOKEN_NAME
environmentVariables.description: API token name. Use this plus PROXMOX_TOKEN_VALUE, or PROXMOX_PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_TOKEN_VALUE
environmentVariables.description: API token secret.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password, used only when no API token is set.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_RISK_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Which tools exist: read-only, plus lifecycle, or everything.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_TOOLS_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names to register, intersected with the risk level. Unset = all of them.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_REDACT_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: Mask cipassword and sshkeys in every response.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: stdio (default) or streamable-http.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP bind address. Anything but loopback also needs PROXMOX_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP port.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_MCP_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint path.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_MCP_JSON_RESPONSE
environmentVariables.description: Answer with JSON instead of an SSE stream.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host headers to accept over HTTP; '*' disables the check.

environmentVariables.name: PROXMOX_MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the endpoint. Empty = same-origin only.

environmentVariables.name: SENTRY_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: report tool traces and errors to Sentry. Unset disables it.
